storage: Keep in an airtight jar away from heat, light and steam, at room temperature; do not shake it over a steaming pot.
looksLike: A fine grey-black powder with a sharp, hot, woody smell. Sold in 50 g to 100 g cartons, pouches and shaker jars.
howToPick: Look for a dark grey-black, uniform powder with a sharp aroma when the pack is opened; a dull smell, clumping or visible pale husk specks suggest age or adulteration. Buy a sealed pack from a known brand.
shelfLife: About 6 to 12 months in a sealed pack; best flavour in the first few months. (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run)

usedIn.raw: only in the Navratri variant swap (about 0.5 g black pepper instead of chaat masala); not in the main recipe
